candidate_404.architecture: Preserves V1 lease_owner + lease_generation authority and adds a boot_id/CLOCK_BOOTTIME clock sidecar; realtime remains telemetry.

target_regression.scope: Frozen V1 25-check process-crash/backpressure corpus through V2 lease; private hash-pinned SQLite 3.53.4.

candidate_404.strength: Strongest current composition candidate because it executes the repaired lease semantics through the actual projection-worker successor and preserves the frozen V1 recovery corpus.
open_risks: boot_id + CLOCK_BOOTTIME does not by itself name the Linux time-namespace clock domain
assert-before-apply window can permit an old generation to enter a separately committed derived-graph apply before takeover becomes visible
large-corpus concurrent V2 shadow-load equivalent to PR#392 remains required

candidate_407.architecture: Binds application-specific host tag + boot_id + Linux time namespace + CLOCK_BOOTTIME deadline + generation and rejects expired renewal under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
candidate_407.strength: Strongest current clock-domain candidate because it explicitly fences same-boot different-time-namespace comparisons and independently rejects expired-generation resurrection.
limitations: isolated lease candidate; not yet composed through the projection-worker crash/backpressure/shadow-load path
host tag is deployment-domain evidence, not hardware attestation
host identity can complicate legitimate state migration and should not be promoted into semantic identity without separate continuity adjudication

fresh_primary_mechanism_evidence.source: Linux time_namespaces(7) / kernel time namespace documentation
fresh_primary_mechanism_evidence.claim: CLOCK_MONOTONIC and CLOCK_BOOTTIME are virtualized with per-time-namespace offsets; therefore equal boot_id does not guarantee comparable persisted BOOTTIME values across different time namespaces.

fresh_primary_mechanism_evidence.source: Linux clock_gettime(3) / Python time CLOCK_BOOTTIME semantics
fresh_primary_mechanism_evidence.claim: CLOCK_BOOTTIME is monotonic/nonsettable for elapsed-duration purposes and includes suspend time, avoiding CLOCK_REALTIME discontinuities.
boot_id is stable for the running boot and can scope a monotonic clock epoch to that boot.
machine-id is stable deployment identity, confidential in raw form, and application-specific identifiers should be derived via cryptographic keyed hashing; it is not hardware attestation.

fusion_decision.import_from_407: Explicit Linux time-namespace clock-domain binding or an executable proof that the production worker is fixed to one namespace and fails closed otherwise.
fusion_decision.host_identity_disposition: KEEP_AS_SEPARATE_CANDIDATE / higher continuity or movable-DB threat-model decision; do not equate with hardware identity.
fusion_decision.reason: The minimum new correctness requirement is BOOTTIME-domain identity. #404 already has stronger end-to-end worker composition evidence, whereas #407 provides the missing domain discriminator.

promotion_blockers: Executable takeover-during-apply regression around the assert -> derived graph commit window
Accepted-target large-corpus concurrent V2 shadow-load no-regression against PR#392 880-event baseline
Explicit time-namespace domain invariant or fixed-namespace deployment proof
Preserve exact-current consequential-use gate and idempotent/rebuildable ClayGraph semantics
architecture_consequence: Do not promote either V2 candidate wholesale. Fuse #404 integration with the minimum #407 clock-domain invariant, keep generation authority singular, then require takeover-race and shadow-load evidence before production activation.
claim_boundary: No production migration or service activation
No hardware attestation claim from machine-id
